body.statement: For a linear Gaussian member of \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{PNHZ}}\) with nonsingular measured covariance, the conditional mean has a unique \(P_{X_A}\)-essential derivative, \(J_{A,B}=\operatorname{Cov}(X_B,X_A)\operatorname{Cov}(X_A,X_A)^{-1}\), so every RankPeel pair lies in \(\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{stab}}(P_X)\) and its law-invariant query rank equals the corresponding cross-covariance rank. The restricted separator upper bounds and private-path lower bounds therefore reduce to Gaussian trek separation and generic noncancellation.
body.justification: The reduction is the required sanity check and locates the nonlinear theorem relative to known linear rank geometry.
body.gap: The linear literature does not supply the nonlinear analytic factorization or this same-class deterministic certificate.
body.consumer: Implementations can validate exact RankPeel transcripts on rational linear Gaussian SEMs before estimating nonlinear Jacobians.
body.proof_tex:
Let \(X\) be jointly Gaussian with nonsingular covariance matrix \(\Sigma\).  For any nonempty measured predictor set \(A\), the principal submatrix \(\Sigma_{AA}\) is positive definite.  With \(\Sigma_{BA}:=\operatorname{Cov}(X_B,X_A)\), the residual
\[
W:=X_B-\mathbb E[X_B]-\Sigma_{BA}\Sigma_{AA}^{-1}(X_A-\mathbb E[X_A])
\]
is jointly Gaussian with \(X_A\) and has zero cross-covariance with \(X_A\).  Factorization of the joint Gaussian characteristic function gives \(W\mathbin{\perp\!\!\!\perp}X_A\), and therefore
\[
\mathbb E[X_B\mid X_A=x]
=\mathbb E[X_B]+\Sigma_{BA}\Sigma_{AA}^{-1}(x-\mathbb E[X_A]),
\qquad
J_{A,B}=\Sigma_{BA}\Sigma_{AA}^{-1}. \tag{1}
\]
Because \(X_A\) has a strictly positive density on \(\mathbb R^{|A|}\), two continuous versions that agree \(P_{X_A}\)-almost surely agree everywhere: otherwise continuity would give a nonempty open ball of disagreement, and that ball has positive probability.  Applying this argument to their coordinatewise differences and then differentiating the everywhere equality shows that all \(C^1\) versions have derivative (1).  Thus every nonempty RankPeel pair belongs to \(\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{stab}}(P_X)\); empty pairs do so by definition.  Since right multiplication by the invertible matrix \(\Sigma_{AA}^{-1}\) preserves rank,
\[
R^{\mathrm{law}}_{P_X}(A,B)=\operatorname{rank}J_{A,B}
=\operatorname{rank}\Sigma_{BA}. \tag{2}
\]

If a latent set \(Z\) \(d\)-separates the two endpoint sets, the directed global Markov property gives \(X_A\mathbin{\perp\!\!\!\perp}X_B\mid Z\).  Gaussian linear projection supplies an affine version \(\mathbb E[X_B\mid Z]=\alpha+\Lambda Z\), and conditional independence plus iterated expectation gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathbb E[X_B\mid X_A=x]
&=\mathbb E\!\left[\mathbb E[X_B\mid Z,X_A]\mid X_A=x\right]\\
&=\mathbb E\!\left[\mathbb E[X_B\mid Z]\mid X_A=x\right]\\
&=\alpha+\Lambda\,\mathbb E[Z\mid X_A=x].
\end{aligned} \tag{3}
\]
The last conditional mean is affine in \(x\), so differentiating (3) shows that the derivative in (1) factors through \(\mathbb R^{|Z|}\) and has rank at most \(|Z|\), together with the elementary bounds \(|A|\) and \(|B|\).  Conversely, the private-path construction in \(\texttt{lem:private-path-lower}\) is itself linear Gaussian and exhibits a nonzero queried minor; generalized rank faithfulness excludes its cancellation for the actual member.  Thus the query-specific upper and lower arguments become exactly Gaussian cross-covariance rank separation and generic noncancellation, as claimed.
